worktree: source: src/engine/tb_eckey.rs, src/engine/tb_pkmeth.rs, src/engine/tb_rand.rs, src/engine/tb_rsa.rs, src/ess/ess_asn1.rs, src/evp/c_allc.rs, src/evp/c_alld.rs, src/evp/e_aes_cbc_hmac_sha1.rs; ledger: REMAINING-AUDIT.txt, AUDITED-FILES.txt, PERFILE-INDEX.md section 59 and this file.
scope: The four still-unaudited engine operation tables named by M52, the ESS ASN.1 item group, the two legacy EVP registration lists, and a substituted next ordinary entry after src/evp/algorithm.rs was confirmed as a provider-dispatch/registry callback boundary. The only repair is the M53-D1 safety-contract wording class: functions that dereference e unconditionally no longer claim NULL was permitted. No production unsafe operation, FFI symbol, allocation extent/line, repr(C) layout, exported signature or unsafe lint attribute changed.

safety_contract_repairs.note: Twenty-one # Safety clauses said e 'must be NULL or point to a live Engine' for ENGINE_unregister_*, ENGINE_register_*, ENGINE_set_default_*, the getter/setter pairs and ENGINE_get_pkey_meth, whose bodies dereference e unconditionally. A permitted input that is UB is not a sound contract; each now requires a non-NULL live Engine. engine_pkey_meths_free keeps its NULL-tolerant wording because it tests NULL; ENGINE_set_pkey_meths now names e explicitly. No code changed.

mechanisms: EC_TABLE static (authority spelling dh_table) and slot
file_dispositions.note: crypto/engine/tb_eckey.c:18-76. M53-D1 contract repair. EC_KEY_METHOD remains opaque in this unit; no method is dereferenced.

crypto/engine/tb_pkmeth.c:18-117. M53-D1 contract repair. engine_pkey_meths_free retains its NULL test and NULL-tolerant contract; the callback must set nids to num_nids integers when it answers a positive count, the same B15/B16 obligation used by tb_cipher.rs.
crypto/engine/tb_rand.c:18-76. M53-D1 contract repair. The unit raises no error, matching the authority.
crypto/engine/tb_rsa.c:18-76. M53-D1 contract repair. RSA_METHOD remains opaque in this unit.

mechanisms: five ASN1_SEQUENCE templates and their field flags
file_dispositions.note: crypto/ess/ess_asn1.c:19-58. Every template flag, offset, item name, tcount and size matches the authority: SEQUENCE_OF, SIMPLE, OPT and SEQUENCE_OF_OPT map to ASN1_TFLG_SEQUENCE_OF/0/ASN1_TFLG_OPTIONAL/SEQUENCE_OF|OPTIONAL. ESS_ISSUER_SERIAL, ESS_CERT_ID and ESS_CERT_ID_V2 keep file-local item accessors; the two signing-cert items publish _it, as nm -D does.

crypto/evp/c_allc.c:21-265. All 199 registration lines of the authority are represented in order; the only absent block is OPENSSL_NO_RC5, which the admitted no-rc5 profile compiles out. Alias target NIDs are object-table entries, so OBJ_nid2sn's static is always non-NULL.
crypto/evp/c_alld.c:18-60. Registration order, the ssl3-md5/ssl3-sha1/sha1WithRSA/ripemd/rmd160 aliases and every enabled digest match the authority; md2 is absent under the admitted no-md2 profile.

mechanisms: AES_128/256_CBC_HMAC_SHA1 compile-time EVP_CIPHER statics and Sync wrapper
init_key / do_cipher / ctrl callbacks over the provider context
file_dispositions.note: crypto/evp/e_aes_cbc_hmac_sha1.c:67-954 (AES-NI arm). The 13-byte AAD length is checked before every p[arg-n] access; encrypt writes 4 version bytes and decrypt copies 13 bytes into the 16-byte aux; md/head state copies use in-structure slots; the provider context is 792 bytes with head/md at the asserted offsets. No defect.

Left in REMAINING-AUDIT.txt.

reconciliation.method: The eight audited files were removed from REMAINING-AUDIT.txt and algorithm.rs was retained as a NOT_RUN boundary; the eight were merged into AUDITED-FILES.txt in path order. Counts are entries, not files touched.

retained_observations: src/evp/algorithm.rs is not a registry table like the tb_* units but the provider algorithm walk; its function-pointer callbacks require the BOUNDARY treatment rather than a contract pass.

The ENGINE_PKEY_METHS_PTR callback must set nids to num_nids integers whenever it answers a positive count. This is the established B15/B16 engine callback obligation, inherited unchanged from the authority; no new hidden obligation was introduced.
The batch contains no secret copy and makes no constant-time claim; engine method tables, ASN.1 templates and legacy name registration are public data, and no cryptographic algorithm was changed.
The M52-D1 NULL-permissive class is now closed across the engine operation tables; no sibling tb_* file in this batch retains that wording except engine_pkey_meths_free, whose body tests NULL.
